commands.name: document_list
commands.description: Lists the documents open in TextEdit, without starting it.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background".

example_requests: What's open in TextEdit?
List my open documents
Which text files do I have open?
commands.precondition: For ui mode, the program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. For background mode, it has Automation for TextEdit.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, a change wasn't seen in time, or TextEdit didn't answer

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
UI mode depends on English names and was tested only in English.
In the test VM, text typed with the keyboard (not pasted) stalled TextEdit's scripting for at least 47 seconds, so background mode can raise UIError after about 30 seconds.
path is None for a document that has never been saved.
It was read back against TextEdit's windows, which isn't independent of TextEdit.

commands.name: document_create
commands.description: Makes a new .txt or .rtf document with text and saves it at a path that doesn't exist yet.

args.name: path
args.meaning: An absolute path, or one starting with ~, ending in .txt or .rtf.

args.name: text
args.meaning: The text to start with.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background".

example_requests: Create a text file called notes.txt in Documents
Make a new document with this text
Write this to a new rich text file
commands.precondition: For ui mode, the program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. For background mode, it has Automation for TextEdit.
commands.postcondition: The file exists and holds the text. In ui mode it stays open; in background mode it's closed.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, a change wasn't seen in time, or TextEdit didn't answer

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: the document has a dialog open, or another app came to the front; nothing is changed

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: the folder doesn't exist; nothing is changed

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.when: the new path is taken; nothing is overwritten

errors.name: OutsideAllowedRoot
errors.when: TEXTEDIT_ALLOWED_ROOT is set and a path is outside it; nothing is done

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Only touches what TEXTEDIT_ALLOWED_ROOT allows if it is set; if it isn't set, any .txt or .rtf file you can reach is accepted.
UI mode depends on English names and was tested only in English.
In the test VM, text typed with the keyboard (not pasted) stalled TextEdit's scripting for at least 47 seconds, so background mode can raise UIError after about 30 seconds.
Only .txt and .rtf were tested; large documents, other encodings and \r\n line breaks weren't.
If the app was still launching, an empty Untitled document can be left open.
